item.title: Cohort’s ELAC wins €140m Saab sonar deal for Polish submarines
item.summary: Cohort has won a €140.7m contract for its German subsidiary ELAC to supply sonar systems for Poland’s new submarine fleet, one of the technology group’s larger deals to date. ELAC, part of its Sensors and Effectors division, will work with Sweden’s Saab to deliver integrated sonar systems for the Polish Orka submarine programme.
